purpose: Validate observed financial trajectories and an operational monitor; not a supervised credit-rating validation
selection: Development seed only: candidates must have at most one adverse alert per eligible company-year on stable and seasonal paths and at most 5% false structural detections on pulse paths. Among admissible candidates select the shortest average delay on deterioration/improvement/recovery. Freeze before validation and test. Report failures rather than retuning on test.

real_data.proxy: future observed cash-flow coverage and its change versus the preceding quarter
limitations: The dataset has already been explored
No historical cash anchor for empirical collapse dates
Bank classifications and product metadata lack historical vintages

reporting.synthetic_false_alarm_rate_unit: emitted adverse alert events per eligible company-year
